`interface IAlBinding`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Lwjgl3AlBinding`](/reference/base-glfw/lwjgl3albinding/), [`Lwjgl2AlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2albinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.openal.binding` · **Module:** `base-openal` · **Source:** [IAlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/openal/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/openal/binding/IAlBinding.java)

The OpenAL calls that `AlAudioBridge` needs, implemented once per LWJGL version.

## Description

A backend gives a binding to [`AlAudioBridge.create`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiobridge/#AlAudioBridge-factory-create), so that base-openal depends on no LWJGL version.
Every method runs on the render thread.

- [Write a binding](/build/base-modules/openal/#write-a-binding)

### getCurrentContext

`Object getCurrentContext()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns an object that identifies the current OpenAL context, or `null` when none is current.
